finalText:
**Redis died at `02:14:07`, and the app never recovered.**

`redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`

Every read fell through to the store. Timeouts started 3 seconds later. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 over 17 minutes. It passed the 500 cap at `02:29:12`. Then `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` and died with code 134. `api` went unresponsive at `02:31:52`.

All 13 reconnect tries failed, spaced a flat 80 seconds apart. Redis was refusing connections the whole time.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` went down. Then add backoff and a cap on the request queue.
